connector.name: Google Tasks MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Manage Google Tasks from MCP-compatible AI clients.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package google-tasks-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ebmurha account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Google OAuth client ID from the user's Google Cloud project.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Google OAuth client secret from the user's Google Cloud project.

env.name: GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI
env.description: OAuth callback URL for the user's local or hosted server.

env.name: DB_PATH
env.description: Persistent SQLite database path for tokens and cache.

env.name: DEFAULT_TASKLIST
env.description: Optional default tasklist title or ID.
